tests.goal: Confirm that the microsite builder works and renders live in Artifacts

steps.action: Open the tools dropdown and ensure Artifacts is enabled (it is on by default).
Select a model.
Ask it to build you a microsite for anything, rendering it live using Artifacts.
acceptanceCriteria: The microsite renders live in the Artifacts panel

tests.goal: Confirm that files generated by Code Interpreter are saved in "My Files"

steps.action: Go to general chat, open the tools dropdown and ensure Run Code is enabled.
Run a prompt that enables Code Interpreter to generate a file.
acceptanceCriteria: That the generated file is saved in the "Files" navigation bar

tests.goal: Confirm that Code Interpreter can perform CRUD operations on files generated in-session

steps.action: Start a new chat, open the tools dropdown and ensure Run Code is enabled.
Prompt the code interpreter to generate files in the session.
Prompt the chat to perform a CRUD test on those files.
acceptanceCriteria: Files can be created, read, updated and deleted in-session
The results of each operation are reported correctly

tests.goal: Confirm that Code Interpreter can write code

steps.action: Start a new chat, open the tools dropdown and ensure Run Code is enabled (it is on by default).
Send "Write a hello world py file using the code interpreter".
acceptanceCriteria: The code interpreter successfully generates hello_world.py

tests.goal: Confirm that Code Interpreter can run code

steps.action: Continue the conversation from TOOLS-004.
Send "Run the hello_world.py file we just made".
acceptanceCriteria: The output is printed in the response

tests.goal: Confirm that Code Interpreter can write and then run code

steps.action: Start a new chat, open the tools dropdown and ensure Run Code is enabled (it is on by default).
Send "Write a hello world py file and run it".
acceptanceCriteria: Hello_world.py is generated and then run

tests.goal: Confirm that Code Interpreter lets users save the code it has written

steps.action: Start a new chat, open the tools dropdown and ensure Run Code is enabled (it is on by default).
Send "Write a hello world py file using the code interpreter".

tests.goal: Confirm that users can edit previously made code files

steps.action: Continue the conversation from TOOLS-004.
Send "Edit the hello_world.py file and turn the same py into hello venus py".
acceptanceCriteria: The code interpreter successfully edits the file

tests.goal: Confirm that users can iterate on work done with Code Interpreter

steps.action: Continue the conversation from TOOLS-008.
Send "Make five changes to the hello_world.py file with different planets".
acceptanceCriteria: The code interpreter edits the file five times

acceptanceCriteria: The Run Code, Skills and Artifacts pills are no longer shown

steps.action: Open the new dropdown on the left of the message bar.
acceptanceCriteria: It lists Run Code, Skills and Artifacts, all enabled by default

steps.action: Use each option with several models.
acceptanceCriteria: Each option works with each model tried

steps.action: Start the guided walkthrough from the learning lab (bottom left).
